detailed_description:
The target video is a single continuous 5-second shot of photorealistic sci-fi suspense, rebuilt from <Video 1>: warm golden sunset realism colliding with an unnatural cold blue presence, the color contrast driving the tension. No dialogue and no on-screen text appear at any point.
[Shot 1] The shot holds a low-angle medium framing from <Video 1>, camera static near the waterline, continuously focused on the two astronauts with the sunset-lit mirror-like water and <Prop 1>, the angular black stealth spacecraft with twin tail fins and its reflection, unchanged in the background throughout. From 0 to 3 seconds, <Subject 1>, the lead astronaut in the white-and-gray armored suit with reflective gold-green visor, and <Subject 2>, the following astronaut slightly behind and left, wade steadily toward the camera through the shallow water, gentle ripples spreading around their legs with each step, rhythmic wading and sloshing sounds synchronized to their strides. At 3 seconds, <Subject 1> abruptly freezes, body going rigid; <Subject 2> stops immediately; both helmets turn sharply toward the right side of the water. Simultaneously, abnormal ripples unrelated to their footsteps begin spreading across the surface, and <Prop 2>, a faint blue glowing band, becomes visible drifting slowly beneath the water on the right, accompanied by a low, subtle ominous underwater hum as the wading rhythm ceases. At 4 seconds, <Prop 2> suddenly accelerates toward the astronauts; <Subject 1> recoils backward in fear with a sharp splash of water, bumping into <Subject 2> behind. From 4.5 to 5 seconds, the light band stops directly beneath their feet and an icy-blue micro-glow blooms in the shallow water around their boots, clashing sharply against the warm golden sunset reflection; both astronauts stand frozen, heads lowered, staring down at the glowing water in near-silence with a faint cold shimmering undertone.

overall_soundscape:
Diegetic sound design only: rhythmic wading and sloshing synchronized with the astronauts' steps from 0–3s; from 3s the rhythm ceases and a low, subtle ominous underwater hum accompanies the drifting blue band; at ~4s an abrupt, sharp splash as <Subject 1> recoils; from 4.5–5s near-silence with a faint cold shimmering undertone.
